title: Incredulous
summary: INCRED'ULOUS, adjective [Latin incredulus; in and credulus; credo, to believe.] Not believing; indisposed to admit the truth of what is related; refusing or withholding belief.

inlines.v: INCRED'ULOUS, adjective [Latin incredulus; in and credulus; credo, to believe.] Not believing; indisposed to admit the truth of what is related; refusing or withholding belief.
